title: Lascivious
summary: LASCIV'IOUS, adjective [Latin lascivus, from laxus, laxo, to relax, to loosen.] 1. Loose; wanton; lewd; lustful; as lascivious men; lascivious desires; lascivious eyes. 2. Soft; wanton; luxurious. He

inlines.v: LASCIV'IOUS, adjective [Latin lascivus, from laxus, laxo, to relax, to loosen.] 1. Loose; wanton; lewd; lustful; as lascivious men; lascivious desires; lascivious eyes. 2. Soft; wanton; luxurious. He capers numbly in a lady's chamber, to the lascivious pleasing of a lute.
